# FURUI blind-04: a second check by an outside witness, recorded after opening

**Status:** an added record. It reports a check of blind-04 made by Federico Blanco (invinoveritas) after the opening files were published. He sent it to us by LinkedIn message on 2026-10-30 at 21:06 JST. The record cites ledger entries 194 to 196 and 202. RESULT.md of blind-04 is anchored and published and is not changed; this record stands next to it. The text below was sent to Federico before anchoring, and he agreed to it.

## 1. What was checked

The opening files at commit dab9540e of horizon-shield (data/furui-blind-04). His summary: "everything agrees, nothing disagreed."

## 2. What he reported

1. Salt. The SHA-256 of its 32 bytes is b846964a...6e07, the commitment anchored before the draw. All 16 file hashes match the README table.
2. Seed. He recomputed it from the salt and block 973697, whose hash (...f745a) he read from mempool.space and from blockstream.info. The seed is 2c3de71e...5550, equal to the manifest.
3. Selection and root. He rebuilt the chain from the 12 dataset files in PINS.txt (every SHA-256 matched) and ran pubprep.py. The blind-02 and blind-03 draws gave roots 46e93653... and 81e87940..., equal to their manifests. The four remaining MEASURE files match the pins of draw_blind04.py. The blind-04 draw gives root 98af4afd...4799, draw_blind04.py verify passes, and his manifest is byte-identical to ours.
4. Recount. He counted from the raw answers and the rule flags with code written from sections 4 and 6 of COUNTING_RULES, not with our tools. Fail-closed, A has 1,872 / 1,648 / 2 and v_028 has 1,566 / 1,342 / 2. This is SCORE_blind04.json exactly: A meets lines 1 and 2 and misses line 3, and v_028 misses lines 1 and 3.

## 3. What he did not check, in his words

> Not checked: the model answers themselves (we didn't re-run any AI stage), and entry 202's OpenTimestamps chain.

## 4. Added by us

- Entry 202 is confirmed on Bitcoin in block 973757, as the ledger shows. This is our statement, not part of his check.
- A separate check by Pavel (Pavlo) Shtomko has its own added record.
- We have worked with him before: he is a co-author of two of our papers and has checked other NENRIN records. No payment was made for this check.

**The SHA-256 of this document is anchored to the JIDEC ledger and stamped to Bitcoin. After anchoring, this record cannot be altered. Corrections are later entries that cite this one.**
